draft.shortGloss: to hold; to carry; to consider; to observe
notes: Often combined with ว่า as ถือว่า (thǔue wâa) to mean 'to consider (that)' or 'to count as'.
Do not confuse with หิ้ว (hîu, to carry hanging from the hand) or แบก (bàaek, to carry something heavy on the shoulder or back).

senses.definition: To grasp or carry something in the hands or arms.

examples.text: เขากำลังถือกระเป๋าใบใหญ่
examples.translation: He is holding a big bag.

senses.definition: To regard or treat in a specified way, or to observe a rule, custom, or belief.

examples.text: เรื่องแค่นี้ไม่ต้องไปถือเขาหรอก
examples.translation: For such a small thing, you shouldn't hold it against him.

examples.text: วันนี้ฉันถือศีล
examples.translation: Today I am observing the religious precepts.

draftBefore.shortGloss: to hold; to carry; to believe; to respect
notes: While ถือ typically means 'to hold' in the hand, it is also used for abstract concepts. When you 'believe in' a religion or hold a specific social belief, you use ถือ.
Be careful not to confuse this with 'แบก' (baek), which specifically means to carry something heavy on your back or shoulders.

senses.definition: To grasp or carry something in your hands or arms while moving.

examples.text: เขากำลังถือกระเป๋าใบใหญ่
examples.translation: He is holding a big bag.

senses.definition: To have a belief, opinion, or follow a religion.

examples.text: เขานับถือศาสนาพุทธ
examples.note: Note that 'นับถือ' (náp-tǔe) is often used for religious belief or high respect.

senses.definition: To consider something important or to strictly observe a rule.

examples.text: เราควรถือคำมั่นสัญญาเป็นสำคัญ
examples.translation: We should consider promises to be important.

faults.quote: เขานับถือศาสนาพุทธ
faults.why: Uses the distinct compound verb นับถือ instead of the headword ถือ.

faults.quote: to hold; to carry; to believe; to respect
faults.why: 'Respect' belongs to นับถือ, not standalone ถือ, and is absent from senses.

faults.quote: To have a belief, opinion, or follow a religion.
faults.why: Senses 1 and 2 overlap and muddle ถือ with นับถือ and ถือว่า.
